payload.title: The counters agentFindingIssuedTotal and agentFindingStateTransitionTotal have no incrementer since FindingRegistryService was deleted, and the doc comment that names the writer is false
evidence: libs/backend-common/src/metrics/orchestrator-metrics.ts:99-110 (agentFindingIssuedTotal and its comment 'Incremented at finding-registry add-time')
libs/backend-common/src/metrics/orchestrator-metrics.ts:244-245 (their only other mention, the registration list)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md one owner per concept: a metric names a writer that exists; its only incrementer, FindingRegistryService, is gone
payload.notes: Both counters export no samples. rule-health-report.yml still names agent_finding_issued_total as the metric its rule-firing rate will read, and nothing can increment it. Close condition: Either the counters and their registration are deleted together with the rule-health-report wait text, or the event writer's CLI-side owner emits them and the comment names it. A grep finds no counter without an incrementer.
